content: Supabase Auth sessions last indefinitely by default (unlimited sessions/devices); refresh tokens do not expire on their own. Time-boxed sessions, inactivity timeout, single-session-per-user are Pro-plan-and-up features — free plan cannot enable them, which means free-tier default = long-lived sessions (satisfies 30+ day requirement). JWT expiry default 1 hour, auto-refreshed by supabase-js (autoRefreshToken:true, persistSession:true localStorage defaults).
